for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
    # We'll split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line.split(' BY ')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    title_part = parts[0].lstrip('- ').strip()
    rest = parts[1]
    # Split rest on " RELEASED_AT "
    if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
        artist_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
    else:
        artist_part = rest
        release_part = ''
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
    songs.append({
        'title': title_part,
        'artists': artists,
        'release': release_part.strip(),
        'line': line
    })
